central_bank_research.title: NY Fed SOMA Manager Perli: reserves ample; overnight rates near IORB; RMPs cut to zero

news.headline: Czech Inflation Breaches Target as Policymakers Mull More Hikes
news.summary: Czech inflation accelerated more than expected last month after the central bank warned that tighter monetary policy may be warranted to tame price growth.

news.headline: Hungarian Central Banker Floats 2031 Euro Adoption Scenario
news.summary: Hungary could adopt the euro as early as 2031 if the government set an ambitious goal of meeting the common currency criteria by 2029, according to central bank Deputy Governor Zoltan Kurali.

news.headline: ECB’s Rehn Says Energy Price Shock Hasn’t Yet Spread to Wages
news.summary: European Central Bank Governing Council member Olli Rehn said the Middle East energy shock hasn’t so far spread to other prices or wages, but those impacts can’t be ruled out.

news.headline: Lescure Says France Is Far From Needing ECB Help on Debt
news.summary: French Finance Minister Roland Lescure said the country is far from needing the European Central Bank to step in even as it wrestles with soaring bond yields.

news.headline: Google, Constellation Near Billion-Dollar Deal for Nuclear Power
news.summary: Google parent Alphabet Inc. is close to an agreement to buy nuclear energy from Constellation Energy Corp., as technology companies race to line up power for the data-center boom.

news.headline: Global Oil Supply Buffer Running ‘Scarily Thin,’ Aramco CEO Says
news.summary: The oil stockpiles that cushion the world from supply shocks have become “scarily thin,” putting markets at risk of worsening unless the Strait of Hormuz reopens, according to the head of Saudi Arabia’s Aramco.

news.headline: Iran’s Oil Minister Resigns as Exports Dry Up Under US Pressure
news.summary: Iran’s Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad resigned citing personal reasons, as the Islamic Republic tries to sustain its oil industry under a tightening US blockade.

news.headline: LNG Trade Through Hormuz Extends Rebound Despite Shipping Risks
news.summary: Shipments of liquefied natural gas through the Strait of Hormuz extended a rebound that began in September, as the region’s producers seek to restore supplies to energy-starved customers.

news.headline: Euro-Zone Inflation Tops Estimates to Hit Three-Year High
news.summary: Euro-area inflation quickened more than expected to the highest in three years, bolstering expectations that the European Central Bank will lift interest rates further.

news.headline: UK Firms Predict Faster Price Increases After Energy Costs Surge
news.summary: The resurgence in oil and gas prices drove up UK businesses’ inflation expectations as firms planned to pass on cost increases to consumers.

news.headline: Pimco’s Stracke Says AI Spending Drove Yields, Not Inflation
news.summary: Surging capital demand from hyperscalers and the AI ecosystem—not inflation expectations—is the primary force pushing real rates and bond yields higher, Pimco’s Stracke said.

news.headline: China Oil Comeback Loses Steam as Iran War Drags On
news.summary: A nascent recovery in Chinese oil demand has begun to falter, as continued fighting in the Middle East and limited Iranian supply keep crude prices too high for private refiners.

news.headline: Man Group Says 5.5% Yields Risk Cracking AI Capex, US Consumer
news.summary: Man Group’s Kristina Hooper warned that surging long-end Treasury yields threaten AI capital expenditures and US consumer resilience.

summary: Overnight markets leaned risk-on: Brent eased to about 100.32 and WTI to 89.43, equities firmed (S&P near 7774, Nasdaq about 27477), and VIX slipped to 15.31, while gold held elevated near 4157. Supply anxiety still lingers—Gulf producers warn buffers are thin and policymakers debate who bears Iran-war energy costs—but the price move suggests the tape is treating the shock as somewhat less acute for now. ECB commentary that energy has not yet fed wages, plus Czech inflation above target, keeps the inflation-versus-growth balance in focus. Ueda did little to push back on October BoJ hike pricing as USDJPY sits near 158. New Zealand domestic demand and household prints could not be verified, so new NZ risk stays off the table. Watch oil logistics, BoJ guidance, and any Treasury-demand headlines.
